integrity: Analytic asymptotic proof and standalone numerical stress tests; numerical experiments are not infinite proof.
scientific_limitations: Fixed deterministic two-parameter alternating inverse branches; alpha in (0,1), beta>alpha. No uniformity as beta approaches twice alpha, no claims on invariant densities, random schedules, or first-return distributions. Historical priority is subject to further literature inspection.
title: A sharp correction-order transition for alternating intermittent inverse branches
